meta.description: Fired ONCE per pay cycle by the HRIS (POST /api/payment-dispatches/cycle-complete) when Payment Dispatch reaches 100% paid — no pending, no blocked payments. The HRIS claims a per-cycle marker before calling, so re-hitting 100% (or several clerks watching at once) never double-sends. Payload carries { cycle, stats, recipients } where recipients = everyone holding the `accounting` role; this flow acks immediately, then emails each person a confetti-and-balloons congratulations (throttled batches of 10, 1s apart; one bad address doesn't stop the rest). Subject/body are fixed in Build Celebration Emails — callers choose only WHO is emailed and which cycle facts show. Import, attach a Gmail OAuth2 credential to the send node, activate, then paste the production webhook URL into Admin → Webhooks under slug `payment_cycle_complete`. Optionally set REQUIRED_SECRET in Build Celebration Emails + N8N_PAYMENT_CYCLE_COMPLETE_SECRET in the HRIS to lock the endpoint.
